scenes.text: You used to be the boss. Nice office. Nice car. People calling you sir.
Now you're thinking about selling coffee on the street, or fixing things for cash. And your pride says, that's beneath me.
Let me be honest. Pride is the most expensive thing a broke man can own.
Every empire started small. Every comeback started with work nobody respected.
Use what you know. Sell what you can. Start with what's in your hands today, not what you had five years ago.
Will people talk? Yes. Will old friends look away? Probably. Let them.
They're not paying your debts. They're not building your future. You are.
Small money is still money. Five dollars today beats zero dollars waiting for the perfect job. Swallow your pride. Then go get your life back.
